text:
Becca Li: flagged during research: the relevance inspector export includes a lot of ambiguous column names (Score vs Relevance) and the ordering is inconsistent with the UI table. users got confused when CSVs were ingested into BI tools.
Hector Ramos: can you paste the exported header sample?
Becca Li: sample header we currently emit: `id, score, vector, source, created_at` — note `score` is ambiguous.
Maya Singh: agreed, `score` should be `relevance_score` and we should add `original_rank` + `current_rank` so teams can track reorders. also add `prompt_preview` (first 200 chars) for quick sanity checks.
A11y QA: CSV export metadata note: include a `display_name` field that matches what screen readers announce in the UI. helps correlate rows when debugging a11y issues.
Hector Ramos: ordering: suggest CSV columns in canonical order: `id, display_name, source, original_rank, current_rank, relevance_score, prompt_preview, vector_norm, created_at`. keep human-readable near the front, heavy numeric/vector fields later.
Becca Li: microcopy: change export file name pattern from `vectors-export-<ts>.csv` to `relevance-inspector-<space>-<date>.csv` where <space> is the project/space slug. makes team ownership obvious when files are downloaded.
Maya Singh: also add a small readme row at top of CSV as comment? CSV can't have comments reliably. alternative: include a companion JSON metadata blob downloadable via the UI or add an `__metadata` column as first row with key:value pairs encoded as JSON string. thoughts?
Hector Ramos: prefer the companion JSON metadata file for parsers. keep CSV pure tabular. make the UI show a checkbox: "Include metadata.json with export" and default to false.
A11y QA: screen reader UX: when export completes, announce "Export ready: relevance-inspector-...csv" in aria-live polite. if metadata included announce both files. ensure focus isn't stolen from the table.
Becca Li: small UX: in the export modal show a sample of the CSV header and let users toggle which columns to include. preview should be single-row sample with truncated prompt_preview and a tooltip explaining vector_norm.
Maya Singh: tooltip copy suggestion for `vector_norm`: "L2 norm of the vector embedding; used to detect outliers." keep copy short.
Hector Ramos: backend: add API param `columns=[...]` and `include_metadata=true|false`. default columns to the canonical order above. also ensure `created_at` uses ISO8601 UTC.
DesignBot: Created issue #5122: "Relevance inspector: canonical CSV headers, filename pattern, metadata companion file, a11y announcements" and assigned to Hector Ramos. :white_check_mark:
A11y QA: i'll add a short test to #5122: export announcement, file naming readout via screen reader, focus retention after export.
Becca Li: i'll prototype the export modal with column toggles and header preview. will drop mocks and copy in the issue by EOW. thanks! :sparkles:
